task.title: Preserve search query, results, and selection when reopening search
task.body:
## Problem

When playing a track, album, or playlist from search (`Enter` / `Shift+Tab`) or closing the search view with `Esc`, reopening search with `/` always clears `m.searchQuery`, resets `m.searchCursor = 0`, and wipes `m.search` via `m.search.SetState(nil, false, nil)` (`internal/tui/model.go:1281-1283` and `2357-2361`).

As noted in #203, if a user searches for an artist or album, plays a result, and presses `/` to return to the rest of the search results, their query, result list, scroll offset, selected item, and open artist drill-down are lost.

## Expected behavior

- Closing search via `Enter` (play track/album/playlist), `Shift+Tab` (play collection next), or `Esc` should preserve `m.searchQuery` and the current `SearchModel` state (results, selected row, scroll position, and open artist album view).
- Pressing `/` in normal mode should reopen search with the previous query, results, and selection intact, placing the text cursor at the end of the query (`len([]rune(m.searchQuery))`).
- `Esc` inside an open artist view continues to step back to the main search results first, and a second `Esc` closes the search overlay back to normal mode.
- Clearing or modifying the query (`Backspace`, `Delete`, `Ctrl+W`, `Ctrl+U`) updates the search and invalidates any in-flight debounce/search responses from earlier queries.

Refs #203.

spec: Preserve search query, results, and selection when reopening search
